## NativeBodyOptions.paged property

Build a list body that reads one page window, given as the body's third argument, and returns a page window result, instead of reading the whole collection into an array (see `PageWindow` and `PageWindowResult`<!-- -->). Meaningful only for a list command of a resource with an identifier. Defaults to `false`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly paged?: boolean;
```
